overall_goal: Scoop, shape, and place cookie dough balls onto the baking tray

goals.description: Get spoons and the bowl of cookie dough ready
goals.rationale: The person retrieves two spoons from the drawer and places the bowl of cookie dough next to the baking tray.

goals.description: Scoop, shape, and place the first cookie dough ball
goals.rationale: The person scoops dough and repeatedly transfers it between the two spoons to form a round ball before placing it on the tray.

goals.description: Scoop, shape, and place several more cookie dough balls
goals.rationale: The person continues to scoop, shape, and place multiple cookie dough balls onto the baking tray.

goals.description: Adjust and resize the cookie dough balls on the tray
goals.rationale: The person moves a fork out of the way, then reshapes, spaces out, and removes excess dough from the balls already on the tray to ensure even sizing.

goals.description: Scoop, shape, and place more cookie dough balls, then adjust their spacing
goals.rationale: The person forms and places more dough balls, scrapes excess dough back into the bowl, and adjusts the spacing and shape of the newly placed balls.

goals.description: Scoop, shape, and place another cookie dough ball
goals.rationale: The person scrapes dough off a fork, shapes it using the spoons, places it on the tray, and cleans the spoons.

goals.description: Pick up fallen dough, flatten baking paper, and place more cookie dough balls
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a fallen piece of dough, smooths out the baking paper, and continues to shape and place more dough balls.

goals.description: Scrape the bottom of the bowl to form and place more cookie dough balls
goals.rationale: The person scrapes the bottom of the bowl to gather remaining dough, shapes it, and places it onto the tray.

goals.description: Scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl to form and place another cookie dough ball, then adjust the shapes
goals.rationale: The person scrapes the sides and bottom of the bowl to form another ball, places it, and then adjusts the shapes and sizes of the balls on the tray.

goals.description: Scrape the remaining dough from the bowl to form and place the final cookie dough ball
goals.rationale: The person gathers the last bits of dough from the bowl, shapes it into a final ball, places it on the tray, and adjusts its position.
